register.labelZh: BREAK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: break down 可以描述機器停止運作;break out 則可以描述火警、打鬥或戰爭突然發生。；break away 可以描述船隻、動物或人突然掙脫;break off 可以描述某部分斷開或一段關係結束。；你可以 break in 新員工或新鞋,也可以用不同活動 break up 漫長的一天,使生活不會那麼單調。；break through 可以描述實際衝破障礙物,也可以表示數字超過重要界線。
register.summaryEn: Break down can describe a machine that stops working, while break out can describe a fire, fight or war that suddenly begins. Break away can describe a boat, animal or person becoming free. Break off can describe a piece becoming separated or a relationship ending. You can break in new staff or new shoes, and you can break up a long day with a different activity. Break through can describe physically passing a barrier or rising beyond an important number.
contextsZh: 清楚談論故障和突發問題
談論適應過程和減少單調感
描述衝破障礙和突破界線
contextsEn: Talk clearly about faults and sudden problems
Talk about becoming ready or making life less repetitive
